summary: Retested local OpenNext worker (http://127.0.0.1:8787) for compare regression and required SEO/product/contact suites. Backend suites passed after correcting stale test expectations; frontend compare stress flow is still not conclusively verified end-to-end due repeated automation instability before results assertion.

ui_bugs.issue: Rapid-selection UI preconditions were observed (3 selections persisted; 4th blocked), but repeatable Compare->results rendering could not be conclusively validated across 3 automation attempts due unstable dropdown/selection automation state before result assertion.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete deterministic evidence for all required post-result checks (differences/print/remove/clear/persistence/RFQ carry-over) because automation could not consistently reach verified compare-results state after refactor within loop-prevention limit.

action_items: Main agent should self-run /compare rapid-select flow manually or with stable network interception script to prove compare-results determinism across 3 independent runs.
If instability reproduces, add explicit loading/error state + compare API call visibility in CompareWorkspace for deterministic E2E assertions.

critical_code_review_comments: compare-workspace.tsx performs compare fetch without explicit try/catch or non-200 handling; UI has no visible API-error state for compare failures, reducing test/debug determinism.
Component is heavily minified/one-line formatted, which hurts maintainability and regression review speed.

success_rate.backend: 100% after test-correction rerun (20/20 contact suite; required broader regression suite previously 45/47 before stale-test fix)
success_rate.frontend: 45% (compare preconditions validated, full acceptance chain not conclusively completed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Loop-prevention reached on compare UI automation after 3 attempts: (1) unsupported wait_for_response method in runner, (2) expect_response timeout despite selection actions, (3) dropdown options intermittently not visible after scripted fill. First run evidence did show quick 3-selection persistence and 4th-option rejection message behavior.
rca of the issue: Primary blocker this iteration was test-runner/automation determinism rather than a confirmed backend failure: compare-related backend tests and /api/products/compare suite passed in pytest (iteration144). Frontend evidence is partial: rapid selection persisted at least once, but reliable repeat proof of compare-results rendering and downstream controls was not completed within 3 allowed retries. Mitigation: use a hardened Playwright harness (input focus + keyboard typing + fetch spy with stable hooks) or manual verification video for final gate sign-off.
